verdict.rationale: The only first-party timeout evidence is a default per-command timeout within a session. That bounds how long a single command runs, not how long the sandbox lives, so it is an adjacent control that does not shut down or stop billing for an idle sandbox. A community reviewer who browsed the docs reports that auto-destroying a sandbox after idle time does not appear possible. Another commenter's remark about Containers auto-shutdown is a host-platform behavior, not a documented, configurable Sandbox timeout.

support.subject: As a developer, I can set timeouts so sandboxes shut down automatically and stop billing when idle or done

citations.quote: You can also set a default command timeout for all commands in a session
